tasks.description: Accept the Auth signup and same-identity conversion link to the immutable registration anchor.
constraints: Independent English Reviewer and QA, read-only exact-diff inspection with local gates. The controller alone changes the fixed narat-staging project and uses synthetic Auth sessions. No model role receives credentials, invokes live Auth or changes production.

Review permanent signup and true-to-false Auth conversion, profile owner isolation, immutable anchor, no legacy backfill, no revival of deleting profiles, lock order and original consumed or in-flight starter. No edits to Auth providers, billing, Edge routes or quotas. Existing historical data must survive clean and upgrade paths.
New tests use actual PostgreSQL triggers and quota RPCs with synthetic auth rows. The live guest provider result and subsequent Auth confirmation are independent controller evidence.
